stem.text: The photomicrograph shows a vascular bundle.

stem.alt: Photomicrograph of a plant vascular bundle with labels 1, 2 and 3 and leader lines to three cells or regions.

stem.text: Which describes the relationship of water potential in the labelled cells?

A.text: Cell 3 is less negative than cell 1.

B.text: Cell 2 is less negative than cell 3.

C.text: Cell 3 is more negative than cells 1 and 2.

D.text: Cells 1, 2 and 3 have the same water potential.
